senses.gloss: to do a thing late, finish in a hurry, in a state of exhaustion.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> (interpret. <he>יעטף</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 102:1">Ps. CII, 1</cite>, with ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 30:42">Gen. XXX, 42</cite>) <he>מה הפועל … לכשיפליג ממלאכתו קימעה ויַלְקִישֶׁנָּה בסוף</he> (not <he>מלאכתו</he>) as a laborer sits waiting for the time when he may rest a while from his labor, and finally finishes it in a hurry (when it is late).
